summary: The official RDC Ministry of Land Affairs and public-service catalogue evidence a national cadastral/register custodian and formal research procedure. No anonymous Ilebo parcel geometry or stable parcel ID endpoint was verified, so no sample GeoJSON was retained.
queryOutcomes: English and French discovery queries, actual result URLs, and outcomes are recorded verbatim in city-3611-ilebo.json under freshResearch. No separate local Ilebo service was found.
requestOutcomes: All executed first-party and bounded public checks are recorded in city-3611-ilebo.json under requestOutcomes. The official form endpoint returned 405 to GET; its POST was not attempted because it requires identity/documents and would create a real request.
scopeLimits: National Ministry evidence is not evidence of a citywide Ilebo open parcel layer.
The service catalogue describes register consultation through local officials but does not expose parcel geometry.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, personal, tax/account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No exact-point hit, extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unavailable UI was treated as citywide absence.
No sample was retained because no safe native parcel identity and full polygon response was verified.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission; serial reviewer qualification remains required.

geometryRetention.reason: No safe, verified native parcel geometry response was available.

uncertainty: Local Ilebo custodian, open parcel coverage, native identity, schema, CRS, geometry API behavior, and completeness remain unverified.
